title: Without Homebrew's bin on PATH (cron, a GUI-started hook) every brewed devbin invocation is refused for bash 3.2, with brew install bash as the remedy though the formula's bash is installed
body:
Under a PATH without Homebrew's bin, every invocation of the brewed devbin is refused for bash 3.2, `/opt/homebrew/bin/devbin` by its absolute path included. Such a process is cron, or a hook that a GUI app starts, which devbin's own pages name. The remedy given, "brew install bash", is wrong: the formula depends on Homebrew's bash, so it is installed, and only PATH lacks it.

dc's from-brew walk of 0.1.15 (2026-10-27) ran each step as a plain brew user under `env -i`, with a scratch HOME (~/Devel/scratch/devbin-dc/walk015/run-20261027-0916Z/: findings.md, and steps/<id>.{out,err,rc}). vc measured each finding against that record and main at 15f2a973.

## Measured

- Steps 107 to 109 (system PATH only) each refuse: "bash >= 5 is required; this is bash 3.2.57(1)-release (/bin/bash) ... install a current one: brew install bash, or apt-get install bash" (lib/helpers:40).
- bin/devbin's shebang is `#!/usr/bin/env bash`, so the bash that runs it is the first one on PATH.

## Fix

- The keg's launcher runs under the bash the formula depends on, whatever PATH holds. dc's design, approved by vc (reviews/design-0251-0253-0254.review.md, sha256 83a86ee3): on macOS, the formula writes a Homebrew env script at the keg's bin/devbin that puts the formula's bash first on PATH (write_env_script), and libexec's launcher is untouched. Rewriting the shebang is ruled out: it breaks the keg manifest's checksum, and upgrades would vendor a Homebrew-only shebang into projects. Linux keeps the symlink. One predicate answers whether a file is the keg's devbin in either layout, and every reader asks it (R1).
- Where a bash >= 5 exists on the machine but not on PATH, the floor refusal names it and gives the PATH remedy, not "brew install bash".

## Done when

1. With PATH set to `/usr/bin:/bin`, the brewed devbin's `--version` and `help` run under Homebrew's bash. This is shown by an install from a local tap, recorded in the Resolution, and by an arm on the rendered formula.
2. The floor refusal names a bash >= 5 that exists off PATH, and the remedy that puts it on PATH. An arm holds it.
3. On a fixture keg laid out as write_env_script writes it, every reader that asks whether a devbin is Homebrew's recognises the keg's env script through the one predicate (R1). `use brew` with a linked keg removes the link and reports brew, a bare `use` reports brew, doctor's switch passes, and 0252's launcher name is `devbin`. Arms hold each.
4. The landing suite passes under BSD and GNU with the tree scans and help, and CI is green on the pushed head.

## Resolution

0253 is fixed by 8e39dc89 (tree 175f25fe), the second of the line's four commits on 6bb2e15c (0251 cdd2f186, then 0253, then 0262 b0ea3fe0, then 0266 f172b06f). 6bb2e15c is the PRE: the version chain's tip 1792ae25 with main's 0257 (landed on main as f3cbab33) picked, and it is not landed again. The chain under the line has since landed on main (0259 1229314e, 0260 e6fd4a98, 0263 4a9bd32e, 0264 ce5d39e1, 0265 7c814e93), and main's code outside intent/ equals 6bb2e15c. l7 was built for this commit: 8e39dc89 amends its predecessor in l6, b1ece04f, on vc's ruling (a), dropping Linuxbrew's path from the floor search's defaults and reverting the l5 amend to neutral.bats (see "The defaults, amended in l7" below). 0251, 0262 and 0266 keep their l6 stable patch-ids. The bundle's tip is the tip the landing run tested, f172b06f.

The design is dc's, approved by vc (reviews/design-0251-0253-0254.review.md, sha256 83a86ee3): on macOS the formula writes a Homebrew env script at the keg's bin/devbin, libexec's launcher is left as published, and Linux keeps the link.

### What changed, against "Done when"

1. **[x] With PATH set to `/usr/bin:/bin`, the brewed devbin's `--version` and `help` run under Homebrew's bash, shown by an install from a local tap and by an arm on the rendered formula.** Accepted by vc (2026-10-28) as written evidence, not as a tap proof of help. The tap showed `--version` from `PATH=/usr/bin:/bin`. help is held by the formula arm and by the critic's probe on 4ee0621a's scratch keg. At f172b06f both answers go through the same launcher under the same bash: the keg's bin/devbin is the env script (packaging/homebrew/devbin.rb:57), which puts the formula's bash first on PATH and runs libexec's bin/devbin, whose `#!/usr/bin/env bash` takes that bash. That launcher sources lib/helpers and runs require_path_bash_floor (bin/devbin:65-66) before it reads any argument, and it sources lib/help (:190) before it answers `-v`, `--version` or `version` (:248). So the floor `--version` passed is the floor help meets, under the same bash.
   - packaging/homebrew/devbin.rb: on macOS, `(bin/"devbin").write_env_script libexec/"bin/devbin", PATH: "#{formula_opt_bin("bash")}:$PATH"`; elsewhere, `bin.install_symlink libexec/"bin/devbin"` as before. libexec's launcher is left as published, so the keg's manifest still matches it and a project vendors the same bytes.
   - The arm on the rendered formula, "the rendered formula runs the launcher under the bash it depends on, by write_env_script, on macOS, and links it on Linux (0253)", compares the install block's `if OS.mac?` branch whole and in order. "devbin's rendered formula is Ruby (0253)" runs `ruby -c` on it, and skips by name where ruby is absent.
   - **The local-tap proof** (vc decision 81(3)) ran on stage 7's tip e3c9c8bb, which carries the line, in slot 01M60MCSZMXN00RHE45661P2N1, END 06:54:28Z on 2026-10-28, released. It took the formula render's pre-publish path (revision from the scratch tag, url the file:// clone, no public repository), so it proves the install of 0253 (the formula's bash), not 0240's public revision or url, which formula.bats holds. e3c9c8bb carried the old defaults line, which named /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin/bash. The change since only removes that path from the defaults list, which the proof's checks did not depend on: the defaults are read only by bash_floor_refuse (lib/helpers, at e3c9c8bb as at f172b06f), and the .out shows `--version` under `PATH=/usr/bin:/bin` exiting 0 and every 0253 check passing, so no refusal ran.
     - It rendered the formula at a scratch tag, v0.0.254, renamed it devbin-dc and keg_only in a scratch tap, tapped it and installed it with brew. No dependency of devbin-dc was outdated.
     - Every 0253 check passed: the keg's bin/devbin is not linked into /opt/homebrew/bin (keg_only); on macOS it is a script, not a link; the script puts the formula's bash first on PATH; `/opt/homebrew/opt/devbin-dc/bin/devbin --version` under `env -i` and `PATH=/usr/bin:/bin` exits 0 and answers as devbin.
     - Cleanup uninstalled and untapped, then read back that the scratch keg, its opt link and the tap directory are gone and `brew tap` lists no devbin-dc/scratch. The trust file, and hv's devbin keg and link and the bash keg, are byte-identical before and after.
     - The output is ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-dc/b0254/tap-proof-01M60MCSZMXN00RHE45661P2N1-2.out, the passing try. The first try, -1, stopped at render before any brew command; b0254/fix-kit-0240.sh fixed it.
   - **`help` from that PATH** is not one of the proof's checks. The critic measured it on the bank 4ee0621a: on a scratch keg whose bin/devbin Homebrew's own write_env_script method wrote, run under `env -i` from `PATH=/usr/bin:/bin`, the env script's `--version` and `help` exit 0 (0253/review/probes/e2e/). That is a scratch keg, not the tap install, and not the tested tip.
2. **[x] The floor refusal names a bash >= 5 that exists off PATH, and the remedy that puts it on PATH. An arm holds it.**
   - lib/helpers, above the load guard and still parseable by bash 3.2: bash_floor_refuse asks `_bash_floor_found`. That looks in `$HOMEBREW_PREFIX/bin/bash` alone when HOMEBREW_PREFIX is set and absolute, and otherwise in the two macOS paths alone, /opt/homebrew/bin/bash and /usr/local/bin/bash. Linuxbrew's bash is found through HOMEBREW_PREFIX, which brew shellenv sets, and a Linux system bash meets the floor on its own; a comment paragraph above bash_floor_refuse says so ("THE DEFAULTS ARE THE TWO MACOS PREFIXES ALONE..."). It names the first that meets the floor, "a bash >= 5 is at <bash> -- put <its dir> ahead of <the refusing bash's own dir> on PATH (for cron or a hook, in the job's own PATH)". Only where none meets it does the refusal say to install one.
   - The floor has one spelling, `_DEVBIN_BASH_FLOOR`, which bash_meets_floor compares against. The load guard, the refusal's search, require_path_bash_floor and doctor's check_bash all ask bash_meets_floor, and each message that states the floor prints the constant.
   - The arms: helpers.bats' "the floor refusal names a bash >= 5 Homebrew has, with the PATH that finds it, and tells no one to install one (0253)", with a stand-in bash 5, and dispatch.bats' "the dispatcher's refusal of an old PATH bash names Homebrew's bash 5, to go ahead of that old bash's own directory (0253)".
3. **[x] On a fixture keg laid out as write_env_script writes it, every reader that asks whether a devbin is Homebrew's recognises the env script through the one predicate (R1).**
   - lib/helpers: brew_answer_state asks is_install_launcher (0252's predicate, both of a keg's layouts) of the PATH hit and of Homebrew's bin link, where it compared resolved paths. Compared that way, the script read as another copy, and `use brew` refused on every macOS brew machine.
   - machinepointer.bats' env_script_keg lays the keg out as write_env_script writes it: a script of its own at the keg's bin/devbin, and Homebrew's bin link to it.
   - "with the keg's bin/devbin a script of its own, as the formula writes it on macOS, use brew removes the link and reports brew, a bare use and doctor's switch read brew, and the hints name devbin (0253)" holds `use brew`, a bare `use`, doctor's switch (`ok    switch: no link, so brew`) and the seed line `devbin install --into <your project>`.
   - "with the keg's bin/devbin a script of its own and Homebrew's bin off PATH, use brew refuses, keeping the link, and names the directory to put on PATH (0253)" holds brew_answer_state's second reader, Homebrew's bin link when PATH does not reach it.
   - As the critic read it, only the `use brew` step of the first arm reads the keg's file: the bare `use`, doctor's switch and the hint are green on the base too, since with no link left none of them asks what PATH finds.
4. **[x] The landing suite passes under BSD and GNU with the tree scans and help.** CI on the pushed head is vc's landing to read.

- **The defaults branch**, measured after vc's floor-constant fix (0253/review/floor-probe.const.out): under `env -i`, `PATH=/usr/bin:/bin` and HOMEBREW_PREFIX unset, /bin/bash 3.2 loading lib/helpers is refused, the refusal names /opt/homebrew/bin/bash with the PATH remedy, and it prints no install line. A relative HOMEBREW_PREFIX answers the same. bash_floor_refuse, `_bash_floor_found`, the constant and the load guard were the same text at l6's tip as at 0cba56d7, the fix that probe followed (compared then). At f172b06f, lib/helpers differs from l6's tip only in bash_floor_refuse's defaults line, which no longer names /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin/bash, and the comment paragraph above it (`git diff 992cd9d8 f172b06f`); /opt/homebrew/bin/bash, the path the probe's refusal named, is still the first default. It was not measured again on the tested tip. 0253/review/defaults-probe.out holds the same answer from the settled bank's launcher, before the constant.
- **formula_opt_bin** was added to Homebrew on 2026-06-22 (47616eaa1d), so a Homebrew older than that with auto-update off fails the install with a NoMethodError.
- **The limit, at this commit:** only the keg's bin/devbin, and Homebrew's bin link to it, run under the formula's bash. libexec's launcher still runs under the bash PATH finds, and at this commit the paths devbin prints for a keg (launcher_shown's fallback and dvb's fallback) still name it. That was filed from this review as 0266, the line's fourth commit, which names the keg's own bin/devbin by its opt link.
- **The defaults, amended in l7:** a light at l6's tip (slot 01M61PN0QRXSJJBRN04NW02S61, END 17:03:16Z on 2026-10-28, released, log ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-dc/l6f/light-01M61PN0QRXSJJBRN04NW02S61.log, red) ran fleet.bats and install.bats, which the line's earlier light had not. It was red on one test under BSD and GNU, install.bats' "no file devbin vendors carries a home-shaped path, and the probe still hits (0109)", at bin/.devbin/lib/helpers:65, where the floor search named /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin/bash among its defaults. That arm's _home_shaped predicate is a hand copy of a consumer project's guard, `git grep -lIE '/Users/[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+|/home/[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+'`, so every consumer with that guard would refuse the helpers devbin vendors. On vc's ruling (a), 0253 drops the Linuxbrew default (Done when 2). The l5 amend that had let neutral.bats' paths arm pass that line is reverted: neutral.bats equals the base, and 0253 no longer touches it. No arm asserted the Linuxbrew default. At f172b06f the consumer's pattern over bin/, lib/ and packaging/ finds nothing. The exact change is `git diff 992cd9d8 f172b06f` in l7/build, which holds l6's objects.
- packaging/homebrew/devbin.rb words Linux as the requirement it is: the system's bash must meet the floor, and devbin refuses one that does not.

### The critic review

- The critic-shell subagent reviewed the bank, 27df1847..4ee0621a: 0 critical, 5 warning, 6 recommendations. The settlement on vc's rulings (209b6719) and vc's floor-constant fix (0cba56d7) settled it, and vc approved the unit. The line carries it as the one commit 8e39dc89.
  - **WARNING (CI's ShellCheck, SC2016):** the child bash's single-quoted `${BASH_VERSINFO[0]}` now carries `# shellcheck disable=SC2016` with its reason.
  - **WARNING (the remedy hard-coded "ahead of /bin"):** taken. The refusal names the refusing bash's own directory, which is /bin in the cron case; dispatch.bats' old-PATH-bash arm holds it.
  - **WARNING (red-control: "brew install bash" printed after naming a bash >= 5):** taken on vc's ruling. The install line prints only where none is found, and helpers.bats' arm refutes it. With it, the lever: HOMEBREW_PREFIX's bash alone when the prefix is set and absolute, the defaults only when it is not, so the existing floor arms stay on the no-bash branch on every machine.
  - **WARNING (scope: every path devbin prints for a keg names libexec's launcher):** ruled outside 0253 by vc and filed as 0266. The formula's headline is narrowed to the keg's bin/devbin, naming devbin#0266.
  - **WARNING (red-control: brew_answer_state's off-PATH reader had no arm):** taken, as the second machinepointer.bats arm above.
  - **Recommendations taken:**
    - the floor's search applies devbin_brew_root's rule, an absolute HOMEBREW_PREFIX alone, and the defaults include Linux's /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew;
      - changed since: the Linuxbrew default is dropped on vc's ruling (a). install.bats' 0109 arm, a hand copy of a consumer's guard against home-shaped paths, was red on it at l6's tip in slot 01M61PN0QRXSJJBRN04NW02S61, so every consumer with that guard would refuse the helpers devbin vendors. The defaults are the two macOS paths alone, and HOMEBREW_PREFIX, when set and absolute, still finds Linuxbrew's bash (see "The defaults, amended in l7" above);
    - one floor comparison, bash_meets_floor, asked at the four places, with vc's constant for the floor itself;
    - the formula's Linux claim scoped as a requirement;
    - `formula_opt_bin("bash")` in place of `Formula["bash"].opt_bin`, as Homebrew/FormulaPathMethods would ask;
    - formula.bats compares the OS branch whole and gives the Ruby check its own arm, skipping by name;
    - `mkdevsrc optsrc`: mkdevsrc's second call with no name, after brew_keg had made devsrc, was a fixture defect beside the arm, re-entering that tree and committing a nested runtime.
- **The critic leg** ran `intent critic shell` on the line's changed shell (12 files, lib/helpers and lib/cmd/doctor among them) and exited 0. It asked 2 of the 6 shell rules.

### Which arms are red on main, and which hold unchanged behaviour

- **Red on 6bb2e15c, for the issue's reason:**
  - helpers.bats' floor arm: the base refusal names no bash and says "install a current one: brew install bash".
  - dispatch.bats' old-PATH-bash arm: the same, under require_path_bash_floor.
  - formula.bats' OS-branch arm: the base template has no `if OS.mac?`.
  - machinepointer.bats' env-script arm: `use brew` refuses at exit 1, "no Homebrew devbin would answer once the link is gone".
  - machinepointer.bats' off-PATH arm: the base says Homebrew's devbin "is not linked" about a linked keg.
- **Green on the base and at the tip:** "devbin's rendered formula is Ruby (0253)". It is a syntax check, which the base template passes too.
- **Unchanged:** the existing floor arms, which stay on the no-bash branch because the test prefix holds no bash (read by the critic); the light ran helpers.bats and dispatch.bats whole.
- **No longer changed by 0253:** neutral.bats, which equals the base at the tip (the l5 amend is reverted, as above); it ran green at the tip in the GNU tree scans. Dropping the Linuxbrew default changed no arm's expected text, since no arm asserted it. install.bats' 0109 arm, red at l6's tip on that default, ran whole and green at the tip under BSD and GNU.

### Evidence

- **Red on 6bb2e15c:** red clone l7/red-6bb2e15c at 08435b43 (6bb2e15c plus the line's seven test files from the tip: contract, dispatch, formula, helpers, localinstall, machinepointer, shellinit; neutral no longer differs from the base), BSD, by the driver's date -u: dispatch 0 ok, 1 not ok (17:06:40Z); formula 1 ok, 1 not ok (17:06:43Z), the ok being the Ruby arm; helpers 0 ok, 1 not ok (17:06:45Z); machinepointer 1 ok, 9 not ok (17:07:03Z), the two 0253 arms among the not ok.
- **Arm greens** at f172b06f, every test passing: BSD dispatch (17:07:12Z), formula (17:07:14Z), helpers (17:07:17Z) and machinepointer (17:07:44Z); GNU dispatch (17:07:53Z), formula (17:07:56Z), helpers (17:07:59Z) and machinepointer (17:08:29Z).
- **The light** at f172b06f, in slot 01M61QKQNRN8Y972DZCVTG0MNY. START was 17:06:29Z and the driver exited 0 at 17:51:42Z on 2026-10-28, both by date -u. The slot ran the line's arms first, then one light. It did not run the version chain's arms again, since the chain has landed on main.
  - Run whole under BSD and GNU, every test passing:
    - version (73), releasecut (140) and doctor (65);
    - helpers (115), dispatch (121), machinepointer (35), formula (34), use (30), shellinit (38), localinstall (62), contract (43), fleet (155) and install (103, its one case-folding skip);
    - help (58).
  - documentation (28) under BSD, and under GNU with the tree scans.
  - The tree scans ran under GNU, and every test passed: neutral (10), documentation (28), readonlygit (11), harness (34, its two expected skips), vendoredmd (3), workroom (5) and installhints (1). helpers and contract ran whole under both.
  - The critic leg exited 0, as above.
  - The log is ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-dc/r23c/run-l7-01M61QKQNRN8Y972DZCVTG0MNY.log, and the TAP is in l7/runs/ (arms/ and light/).
- **The local-tap proof:** slot 01M60MCSZMXN00RHE45661P2N1, on e3c9c8bb, END 06:54:28Z on 2026-10-28, released; as recorded under Done when 1.
- **The bundle:** see SHA256SUMS in this directory (`line.bundle`, ref l7 at f172b06f, on 1792ae25).
- **The landing:** vc landed it at 59f01d48 with land-stack.sh (LAND_BASE_OFF_MAIN=1), commit by commit, as run. Its paths equal the tested tip's. The BSD and GNU full suites run once before the cut, and CI reads the pushed head.

- **CI:** run 40752126678 on the pushed head a6a875b3, which carries the landing, read green by vc.
